nonlinear_policy.acceptance: all substeps and the combined step must close their entropy/heat ledgers
nonlinear_policy.coefficients: frozen for one accepted split step
nonlinear_policy.reanchor: explicit only after the step; no mid-step coefficient mutation

spatial_discretization.entropy_coordinates: the frozen anchor coordinates with A0=I
spatial_discretization.equivalent_operator: skew centered derivative tensor A_r plus symmetric negative jump penalty
spatial_discretization.grid: periodic uniform proof grid; boundaries require a later SAT certificate

time_discretization.composition: source half-step, transport full-step, source half-step
time_discretization.local_ports: implicit midpoint/Cayley update of the frozen source generator
time_discretization.source_ledger: reservoir loss equals thermal heat deposit exactly at the midpoint
time_discretization.transport_ledger: energy change equals midpoint numerical-interface dissipation
